1.web: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
1.asv: The wicked flee when no man pursueth; But the righteous are bold as a lion.

2.web: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.
2.asv: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof; But by men of understandingandknowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.

3.web: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.
3.asv: A needy man that oppresseth the poor Islikea sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

4.web: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.
4.asv: They that forsake the law praise the wicked; But such as keep the law contend with them.

5.web: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek Yahweh understand it fully.
5.asv: Evil men understand not justice; But they that seek Jehovah understand all things.

6.web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity, than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
6.asv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, Than he that is perverse inhisways, though he be rich.

7.web: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.
7.asv: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son; But he that is a companion of gluttons shameth his father.

8.web: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
8.asv: He that augmenteth his substance by interest and increase, Gathereth it for him that hath pity on the poor.

9.web: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
9.asv: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, Even his prayer is an abomination.

10.web: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.
10.asv: Whoso causeth the upright to go astray in an evil way, He shall fall himself into his own pit; But the perfect shall inherit good.

11.web: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.
11.asv: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; But the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.

12.web: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
12.asv: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; But when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

13.web: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
13.asv: He that covereth his transgressions shall not prosper; But whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall obtain mercy.

14.web: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
14.asv: Happy is the man that feareth alway; But he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.

15.web: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
15.asv: Asa roaring lion, and a ranging bear, So isa wicked ruler over a poor people.

16.web: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
16.asv: The prince that lacketh understanding is also a great oppressor; Buthe that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.

17.web: A man who is tormented by life blood will be a fugitive until death; no one will support him.
17.asv: A man that is laden with the blood of any person Shall flee unto the pit; let no man stay him.

18.web: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
18.asv: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be delivered; But he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.

19.web: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
19.asv: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread; But he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.

20.web: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
20.asv: A faithful man shall abound with blessings; But he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be unpunished.

21.web: To show partiality is not good; yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
21.asv: To have respect of persons is not good; Neither that a man should transgress for a piece of bread.

22.web: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
22.asv: He that hath an evil eye hasteth after riches, And knoweth not that want shall come upon him.

23.web: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.
23.asv: He that rebuketh a man shall afterward find more favor Than he that flattereth with the tongue.

24.web: Whoever robs his father or his mother, and says, “It’s not wrong.” He is a partner with a destroyer.
24.asv: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression, The same is the companion of a destroyer.

25.web: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.
25.asv: He that is of a greedy spirit stirreth up strife; But he that putteth his trust in Jehovah shall be made fat.

26.web: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
26.asv: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool; But whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.

27.web: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.
27.asv: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack; But he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.

28.web: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
28.asv: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; But when they perish, the righteous increase.
